name: World of Hyatt Business

benefits.name: 2x Points on Top Three Spending Categories
benefits.description: 2 bonus points per $1 in the cardholder's top three eligible spending categories each quarter, applied automatically.
benefits.terms: Applied automatically to the three highest-spend eligible categories each quarter; no enrollment or selection required.

benefits.name: Hyatt Spending Credit
benefits.description: $50 statement credit per qualifying Hyatt purchase of $50 or more, up to two times each anniversary year for a total of $100.
benefits.terms: Issued as $50 per qualifying Hyatt transaction of $50 or more, maximum two per anniversary year.

benefits.name: World of Hyatt Discoverist Status
benefits.description: Complimentary World of Hyatt Discoverist elite status for as long as the account is open and in good standing.

benefits.name: 5 Discoverist Upgrade Awards
benefits.description: 5 Discoverist Upgrade Awards to gift complimentary Discoverist status to up to five employees.

benefits.name: Tier-Qualifying Night Credits from Spend
benefits.description: 5 World of Hyatt tier-qualifying night credits for every $10,000 in purchases each calendar year.

benefits.name: 10% Points Back on Redemptions After $50,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: After spending $50,000 in a calendar year, receive 10% of redeemed points back on up to 200,000 World of Hyatt points redeemed.
benefits.terms: Requires $50,000 in purchases in a calendar year. Bonus applies to a maximum of 200,000 redeemed points.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: 12 months of complimentary DoorDash DashPass membership.
benefits.terms: Requires activation by Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this deadline is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Quarterly DoorDash Credit
benefits.description: Up to $10 in DoorDash discounts each quarter.

benefits.name: Hyatt Leverage Program Membership
benefits.description: Membership in the Hyatt Leverage program, offering negotiated corporate rates at Hyatt properties.

benefits.name: Employee Cards at No Additional Cost
benefits.description: Employee cards at no additional cost, with purchases earning points into the primary account holder's World of Hyatt account.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars, up to $60,000.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Adds one year to eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less.

earningRates.terms: 4x bonus points on qualifying purchases at Hyatt hotels, on top of up to 5 base points earned as a World of Hyatt member.
